name: k0ntmination-scanner-extension
description: Minimal browser extension packaging scripts for K0ntmination Scanner

scripts.build:dist: npm run clean && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-dist.ps1
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:dist && npm run zip:chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:dist && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.package:all: npm run build:dist && npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
